exclusions.name: Bank supervisor Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule, so her actions do not affect the number of units received.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the centre's stock after Monday collection and Tuesday collection before dispatch is at least 150 units to ship on Tuesday. This depends on the exact collection amounts on Monday and Tuesday morning, which are not directly given but can be inferred from the average rate and hours open.

Whether the centre's stock after Wednesday collection and Thursday collection before dispatch is at least 150 units to ship on Thursday. This depends on the exact collection amounts on Wednesday and Thursday morning, which are not directly given but can be inferred from the average rate and hours open.

Whether the Tuesday shipment arrives before the deadline (Friday noon). The shipment is dispatched at 4:00 PM Tuesday and takes about 3 hours, so it arrives Tuesday evening, well before Friday noon. This is certain.
Whether the Thursday shipment arrives before the deadline. Dispatched at 4:00 PM Thursday, takes about 3 hours, arrives Thursday evening, before Friday noon. Certain.
The hospital's initial stock at the start of the week is given as 15 units. Certain.
The centre's initial stock at 9:00 AM Monday is given as 40 units. Certain.
The collection on Monday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (8 hours) at 12 units/hour = 96 units. Certain.
Collection on Tuesday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (7 hours) at 12 units/hour = 84 units. Certain.
Centre stock after Tuesday dispatch: initial 40 + Monday 96 + Tuesday 84 = 220, minus 150 shipped = 70. Certain if shipment occurs.
Collection on Wednesday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (8 hours) = 96 units. Certain.
Collection on Thursday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM (7 hours) = 84 units. Certain.
Whether the Tuesday shipment is dispatched. Since centre stock before dispatch is 220, which is >= 150, it is dispatched. Certain.
Whether the Thursday shipment is dispatched. Centre stock after Tuesday dispatch is 70, plus Wednesday 96 = 166, plus Thursday 84 = 250 before dispatch, so >= 150, dispatched. Certain.
